portfolio.title:
One incident.
One shared picture.
portfolio.intro: Keep services, incoming signals and response decisions together. A durable timeline gives the next responder the context to continue.
portfolio.local: Static portfolio demo is published on GitHub Pages. The live RelayOps runtime is not publicly hosted.
portfolio.operationsText: Active incidents, service health and the next action.
portfolio.workbenchText: Server-side filters, shareable URLs and saved views.
portfolio.boardText: Permission-checked transitions with keyboard and menu alternatives.
portfolio.roomText: Durable updates, participants, signals and conflict-aware commands.
portfolio.servicesText: Service ownership, runbooks and reversible archiving.
portfolio.analyticsText: MTTA, MTTR, explicit samples and links back to the incidents.
portfolio.architecture: PostgreSQL is the record. Realtime keeps the team current.
portfolio.architectureText: A single instance runs without Redis. Existing Kaneo data remains in an explicit read-only archive; incidents are a separate domain.
portfolio.provenance: Derived from the MIT-licensed Kaneo project. Original copyright: Andrej Acevski. RelayOps is an independent fork and is not endorsed by Kaneo.
